title: podman secret create --replace=true name file  fails with error if 'name' does not already exist.
body:
### Issue Description

Run `podman secret create --replace=true name file ` and it fails to create a new secret. 

### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue
1. Ensure the secret `name` does not exist
2. `podman secret create --replace=true name file `


### Describe the results you received

An error.

### Describe the results you expected

The secret is created.
